resources.string: Touch a row and hold. It goes down 1.5 dp and is back before the click arrives.
The card stays. Only what you touch moves, and nothing changes colour.
Five effects, each with one meaning. Each button here ticks first, as every button does, then plays its effect.
The finger crossed into another option while dragging.
An action was refused or failed validation.
%1$s was not played: Haptics is off on the Appearance page
All five follow the Haptics setting on the Appearance page. When it is off, every call does nothing. Older Android versions play the nearest effect they have.
A control that holds a value tells you first. An action ticks first.
The log is empty. Use the switch or the button.
The switch calls its listener while it starts to glide, then ticks. The button ticks at once, because its listener may open something slow.
Extracted from the original app: the 1.5 dp sink without a colour change, and the tick on a committed change. New in Sancai: SancaiPress for your own rows and the five named effects of SancaiHaptics.
